name: Jones County, TX
findings: Jones County has 35 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (62% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Jones County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Jones County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 5 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do social and fraternal organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
